description: 1. Agent reads ~/.flyai/user-profile.md to retrieve the pre-existing user profile (file-mode storage per user-profile-storage.md). 2. Agent installs the flyai CLI via `npm install -g @fly-ai/flyai-cli@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`. 3. Agent runs `flyai --help` to verify installation. 4. Agent executes three parallel data collection commands for each of the 3 destinations: `flyai search-flight --origin '北京' --destination '{dest}' --dep-date 2024-10-15 --back-date 2024-10-20 --sort-type 3` (note: must use `--sort-type 3`, not generic sort flags), `flyai search-hotel --dest-name '{dest}' --check-in-date 2024-10-15 --check-out-date 2024-10-20 --sort rate_desc` (note: `--sort rate_desc` not `--sort-by`), and `flyai search-poi --city-name '{dest}'`. 5. Agent computes total cost estimates using the formula: 机票往返中位价 + 酒店每晚均价 × 5晚. 6. Agent generates star ratings (⭐1-5) for each attraction category (寺庙古迹类, 自然风光类, 网红打卡类, 水上活动类, 亲子娱乐类). 7. Agent outputs the 3-way comparison card in the exact format from SKILL.md三地对比扩展格式 with ━━━ borders, ─────── dividers, 🆚 header, and a table layout. 8. Agent applies the budget-preference recommendation logic (Step 5 of core-workflow.md): 首尔 wins because it has the lowest combined flight+hotel cost. 9. Agent writes the final report to the exact specified path with a 👉下一步 action section. The key traps are: using `--sort-type 3` for flights (not generic), using `--sort rate_desc` for hotels (not `--sort-by`), using the specific Unicode border characters ━ and ─, generating ⭐ star ratings by category, and correctly implementing the budget-first recommendation logic to identify 首尔 as the winner.
